description: Search SetupBay for rule/skill/MCP bundles. Ranked by relevance to `query`; filter by agent, tags (stacks such as nextjs, godot, python) or category. With no query, lists loadouts (featured and verified first).

agent.description: Only loadouts that support this agent

has.description: Only loadouts containing skills, MCP configs or rules

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'nextjs supabase auth' or 'discord bot'

tags.description: All of these stacks/categories must match, e.g. ["typescript"]

verified_only.description: Only loadouts that passed the Level 1 automated install check

name: search_loadouts
title: Search loadouts
